# FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief

Problem: A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.
Pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://faie.base44.app/functions/faieAgentGateway?view=docs

Use when the user says or means:
- research this land or water question
- investigate this agriculture signal
- give me an evidence brief on this region
- validate this environmental signal
- do a resilience investigation

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
